convert_checkpoint: convert an official VidEoMT checkpoint from tue-mps/VidEoMT to Hugging Face transformers format
verify_conversion: verify a converted VidEoMT model matches the GitHub reference implementation within tolerance
build_reference_model: build a reference VidEoMT model from the GitHub repository for forward-pass verification
rename_state_dict_keys: rename and split state dict keys from the original VidEoMT checkpoint to Hugging Face format
infer_videomt_config: infer a VideomtConfig from a checkpoint's state dict including hidden size, layers, and attention heads
